src:
MOV     AX, 0013h        ; 320x200, 256 colours
INT     10h
MOV     DX, 92           ; rows 92 to 107
ROW1:
MOV     CX, 32           ; x from 32 to 287
DOT1:
MOV     AL, CL
SUB     AL, 32           ; colour = x - 32: 0..255 along the line
MOV     AH, 0Ch          ; write the pixel
MOV     BH, 0            ; page 0
INT     10h
INC     CX
CMP     CX, 288
JB      DOT1
INC     DX
CMP     DX, 108
JB      ROW1
MOV     CX, 001Eh        ; wait 2 s: CX:DX = 1E8480h microseconds
MOV     DX, 8480h
MOV     AH, 86h          ; BIOS: wait
INT     15h
MOV     AX, 0003h        ; mode 03h again: 80x25 text, clears the screen
INT     10h
MOV     AH, 09h
MOV     DX, OFFSET MSG1
INT     21h

MSG1    DB      "Back in mode 03h", 13, 10, "$"
